brand.name: Rusty MCLA
foot.fan: Fan project. Not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. Requires your own copy of the game.
home.ready_line: Game v{0} with data built from your disc
notes.label: What's new
home.wrong_text: Export your logs and attach them to an issue on GitHub. Your Windows user name is removed first.
fr.title: Let's get you set up
fr.text: The launcher builds the game's data from your own disc image, once. After that, this screen is the Play button.
fr.takes: Takes a few minutes, mostly converting the sounds.
fr.need1: Your own Xbox 360 disc image (.iso) of Midnight Club: Los Angeles, Complete Edition (USA, Europe).
fr.need2: About 15 GB of free space. The disc image itself is not copied.
fr.need3: An internet connection for the first download, or a game package you already have.
fr.legal: The launcher does not include the game or any of its files. Everything it builds comes from your disc and stays on this computer.
fr.s1_d: Downloads the game program from the latest release.
fr.s2_d: Pick the .iso. It is checked before anything is built.
fr.s3_d: Turns your disc into the files the game reads.
fr.offline_link: Use a game package I already have
dyn.chk4: File size matches the supported edition
dyn.chk_hash: Full checksum, checking in the background
ins.dump_note: A different dump of the disc may still work. You get a warning, not a block.
ins.keep_note: Your save and logs are kept elsewhere on this computer, so deleting or moving this folder never loses your save.
dyn.cancel_note: Cancelling keeps your progress, so you can resume.
ctl.kbd_intro: 32 actions, up to two keys each. These are the same bindings as the game's own Options page.
ctl.change1: Click a key box, then press the new key.
ctl.change2: Press Backspace to clear it, Esc to cancel.
ctl.change3: If the key is already used you are asked before it moves.
ctl.pad_text: The gamepad uses the original game's layout. Its mapping editor is in the game's Options page, and the launcher shows it read-only.
ctl.fixed_note: These cannot be rebound. F12 takes a screenshot.
ctl.pad_intro: The layout the game is using for [controller style]. Read-only here.
ctl.pad_ok: Plugged in and recognised. If none is found, the keyboard works as usual.
ctl.change_layout_text: The gamepad layout and its mapping editor live in the game's own Options page, the same as on the original. Open the game, then Options, then Controller.
ctl.vib_note: They arrive once the game can use them.
ctl.no_save: No save yet, so these are the game's default keys. Start the game once (it makes your save), then come back here to change them.
ctl.save_error: Your save could not be read, so nothing can be changed here: {0}
ctl.save_odd: The keyboard part of your save could not be read, so the defaults are shown. Changing a key writes it fresh.
ctl.saved_bak: Saved (your save was backed up first)
ctl.ref_reserved: {0} is kept by the game and cannot be bound.
ctl.ref_alt_enter: Alt+Enter switches the window mode and cannot be bound.
ctl.ask_text: {0} is already used for {1}. Move it to {2}?
sup.export_text: One zip file with everything needed to look into a problem with building, installing or playing. Nothing is sent anywhere.
sup.user_note: Your Windows user name is replaced in every path before anything is written.
sup.rep2: Open a new issue. Your version numbers are filled in.
sup.rep3: Drag the zip into the issue and describe what happened.
sup.rep_note: Please do not post or ask for game files or disc images in issues.
set.check: Check when I open the launcher
set.check_d: You always choose whether to update.
set.pick_ver_d: Go back if a new one gives you trouble.
set.close: Close the launcher when the game starts
set.close_d: Nothing keeps running in the background.
set.backup: Back up my save before every update
set.notes: Show the release notes after an update
set.lang_d: The game has its own language setting.
set.lang_note: Translations are plain text files. A missing language falls back to English one line at a time, so a partly translated launcher still works.
set.remember: Remember the window size and place
set.theme_d: Changes apply at once and are saved on this computer.
set.rotate_d: If the folder is empty, the launcher shows its own artwork.
set.display_note: In the game, OPTIONS > DISPLAY and OPTIONS > PERFORMANCE change these at once; here they take effect the next time the game starts. Original is the original game's own setting. Shadow resolution always needs a restart. Upscaling is not in the game yet.
set.o_drawdist_d: Draws the city further out. Traffic and walkers still appear and disappear where the original makes them, so they cannot be seen past about 400 m and 150 m.
set.mon_gone: {0}. Not connected now (the game uses the main one)
set.mon_broken: settings.toml is damaged; fix or delete it first
f.install_d: Holds the game and its data
f.note: Your save, backups and logs are kept in your user folder, apart from the install folder, so deleting or moving the install folder never loses them.
about.fan: This is an unofficial fan project. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. It contains no game data: it reads your own copy of the disc on your computer, and nothing from the original game is distributed with it.
about.nofiles: Please do not ask for, or share, game files or disc images anywhere in this project.

toast.later: That part of the launcher is not built yet.
toast.folder_missing: That folder does not exist yet.
mods.compat_game: Made for game v[0.0.0] and later
mods.conflict_with: Changes the same car as [Other mod]
mods.folder_note: Mods live in their own folder and are meant to sit beside the game data built from your disc, never inside it.
music.file_types: Plays [file types the game can play].
music.spotify_note: Planned: show what Spotify is playing and control it from the game. What this can do depends on Spotify's own rules, which are settled before it ships: [what Spotify allows].
dyn.hash_ok: Checksum matches the known good dump
dyn.hash_other: Checksum differs from the known dump. It may still work.
dyn.cancelled: Stopped. Your progress is kept; press Resume build to continue.
dyn.built_note: Done. Your game data is ready.
dyn.need_disc: Choose your disc image to begin.
dyn.ready_note: Ready. The disc image itself is not copied.
dyn.ffmpeg_note: Downloads ffmpeg {1} once ({0}) to convert audio and video.
dyn.log_problems: {0} sounds could not be converted (see the build log)
dyn.verify_bad: {0} files are missing or damaged. Choose the disc and press Resume build to repair them.
dyn.fr_need2: About {0} of free space. The disc image itself is not copied.
dyn.fr_takes: Takes a few minutes, mostly converting the sounds.
dyn.err.cancelled: Stopped. You can resume later; finished work is kept.
dyn.err.unreadable: The file cannot be read. Check that it exists, is not in use, and (for a network drive) is reachable.
dyn.err.not_an_image: This is not a disc image. Choose the .iso file of the Xbox 360 disc (not a folder, a Games on Demand package or a .xex).
dyn.err.compressed_image: This image is compressed or archived. Unpack it to a plain .iso first (for example with 7-Zip), then choose the .iso.
dyn.err.truncated: The image is smaller than the disc it should hold. The copy or download is probably incomplete.
dyn.err.not_xbox360: This file is not an Xbox 360 game disc image (no readable Xbox disc layout).
dyn.err.wrong_game: This is an Xbox 360 disc, but of a different game. Choose the Midnight Club: Los Angeles - Complete Edition disc.
dyn.err.unsupported_edition: This looks like the right game, but not the supported edition or region (Complete Edition, USA / Europe). Its data cannot be read.
dyn.err.missing_file: A required file is missing from the disc image. The image is probably incomplete or a different release.
dyn.err.disk_space: Not enough free space in the install folder's drive.
dyn.err.not_writable: The install folder cannot be written to. Choose another folder or check its permissions.
dyn.err.path_too_long: The install folder's path is too long. Move the launcher to a shorter folder (for example C:\RustyMCLA).
dyn.err.bad_folder: This folder cannot be used for the install. Choose another one.
dyn.err.ffmpeg_missing: ffmpeg was not found and could not be fetched. Put an ffmpeg.exe in the tools\ffmpeg folder, or connect to the internet and resume.
dyn.err.ffmpeg_download: ffmpeg could not be downloaded. Check the internet connection and resume, or put an ffmpeg.exe in the tools\ffmpeg folder.
dyn.err.ffmpeg_hash: The downloaded ffmpeg did not match its expected checksum and was discarded. It was not run.
dyn.err.convert: ffmpeg could not convert one of the files. See the build log.
dyn.err.manifest: The install manifest is damaged or from a newer launcher.
dyn.err.shaders: The sky, road and sea shader programs could not be translated from the game data. See the build log.
dyn.err.data_damaged: The built data folder is incomplete or damaged. Choose the disc and press Resume build to repair it.
dyn.err.io: A file could not be written (disk full, access denied or the file is in use).
ver.title: Install a specific version
ver.note: Replaces the game files with the release you choose; the launcher itself stays as it is. If that release needs different game data you are asked to rebuild it from your disc. Your save is backed up first.
dyn.notes.none: No release notes yet. They appear here once the launcher has been online.
dyn.upd.avail: v{0} is ready. Your save is backed up first.
dyn.upd.avail_launcher_first: v{0} is ready. The launcher updates first, then the game.
dyn.upd.rebuild_warn: This version needs your game data rebuilt from your disc afterwards. Skip it to keep your game and data as they are.
dyn.upd.swapping: Putting the new game in place
dyn.upd.done: Game v{0} is installed. The previous game is kept until the next successful start.
dyn.upd.rebuild: The game was updated and needs its data rebuilt from your disc. Until then the old data does not match.
dyn.upd.offline: You can still play. Updates are checked again when you are back online.
dyn.upd.rate: GitHub is limiting requests for now. Try again after {0}. You can still play.
dyn.upd.failed: The release server did not give a usable answer. You can still play.
dyn.upd.manifest_failed: The latest release cannot be installed by this launcher ({0}). You can still play.
dyn.upd.toast_latest: You are on the latest version.
dyn.upd.toast_skipped: Skipped v{0}. You can clear this in Settings.
dyn.upd.toast_off: Update checks are switched off in Settings. Checking once now.
dyn.upd.ready_no_game: Game files are not installed yet
dyn.upd.st1_error: Could not get the game files
dyn.upd.err.offline: No connection to the release server.
dyn.upd.err.rate_limited: GitHub is limiting requests for now. Try again later.
dyn.upd.err.http: The release server answered with an error.
dyn.upd.err.bad_response: The release server's answer could not be read.
dyn.upd.err.too_large: A download is larger than allowed and was refused.
dyn.upd.err.manifest: The release's manifest is damaged or from a newer launcher. Nothing was changed.
dyn.upd.err.hash: The download did not match its expected checksum and was discarded. Nothing was changed.
dyn.upd.err.size: The download is incomplete or the wrong size and was discarded. Nothing was changed.
dyn.upd.err.signature: The new launcher could not be verified, so it was not installed. Nothing was changed.
dyn.upd.err.zip: The game package is not valid or tries to write outside its folder. Nothing was changed.
dyn.upd.err.policy: A link in the release points somewhere that is not allowed and was refused.
dyn.upd.err.io: A file could not be written (disk full, access denied, or the game is running).
dyn.upd.err.missing: The release does not contain what is needed.
dyn.upd.err.unknown_package: This file is not the game package of any known release. Put the release's manifest.json beside it, or download the package again.
set.prev: Go back to the previous game version
set.prev_d: Only while the previous version is still kept.
dyn.sup.report_opened: The issue page is open in your browser. Attach the zip there.
dyn.sup.save_included: Your save will be in the zip. It holds your progress.
dyn.sup.no_save: No save yet. The game makes it the first time you play.
dyn.sup.no_backups: No backups yet. BACK UP NOW makes one.
dyn.sup.restore_text: Your save becomes the one from {0} ({1}). The save you have now is backed up first, as "Before restore", so you can undo this.
dyn.sup.import_text: It replaces your current save. The save you have now is backed up first, as "Before import".
dyn.sup.import_orig_title: Convert this save of the original game?
dyn.sup.import_orig_text:
This is a save from the original game ({0}). It is converted for this game and replaces your current save.

What is carried over:
- the garage: {1} cars with their parts, paint, vinyls and tuning
- money {2}, reputation {3}, {4} career missions ({5} finished), {6} statistics
- {7} collectables, {8} race editor races, {9} favourite races
- the options: volumes, subtitles, camera shake, steering, music genre

Kept from your current save: your key bindings and anything else only this game stores. The save you have now is backed up first, as "Before import".
dyn.sup.platform_xbox360_pkg: Xbox 360, taken out of the console's save package
dyn.sup.running_title: The game seems to be running
dyn.sup.running_text: Changing the save or the game folder while the game runs can lose progress or fail. Close the game first, or go ahead anyway.
dyn.sup.err.io: A file could not be read or written.
dyn.sup.err.not_allowed: The export refused to include a file that is not on its list. Nothing was written.
dyn.sup.err.url: The issue link could not be made.
dyn.sup.err.no_save: There is no save to back up yet.
dyn.sup.err.not_a_save: That file is not a save of this game. Choose a save file (mcla_save.json) or one of the backups.
dyn.sup.err.too_big: That file is far too big to be a save.
dyn.sup.err.same_file: That is the save you are using already.
dyn.sup.err.backup_damaged: That backup is damaged and was not restored. Your save is unchanged.
dyn.sup.err.game_running: The game is running. Close it first.
dyn.sup.err.original_damaged: This looks like a save from the original game, but it could not be read, so nothing was changed. Check that it is the whole mc4.sav / RAGE.SAV file.
dyn.sup.err.no_data: Converting a save from the original game needs the game data (it names the races). Build the data from your disc first (Install), then import again.
dyn.sup.err.ps3: This is a PlayStation 3 save folder, but its PARAM.PFD or its RAGE.SAV is missing or not readable. Choose the whole save folder (PARAM.PFD, PARAM.SFO and RAGE.SAV together).
dyn.sup.err.ps3_key: This PlayStation 3 save could not be decrypted. The launcher opens saves of the US release (BLUS30190); a save of another region or another game, or a damaged file, does not work.
dyn.sup.err.xbox_package_no_save: This is an Xbox 360 package, but it does not hold a Midnight Club: Los Angeles save (mc4.sav). Choose the package of this game's save.
dyn.sup.err.xbox_package_damaged: This is an Xbox 360 package, but it could not be read (damaged, cut off, or not a save package), so nothing was changed. Copy it from the console or the memory unit again.
dyn.play.crash_title: The game closed unexpectedly last time
dyn.play.crash_text: Export your logs to help find out why.
dyn.play.err.missing_exe: The game program is missing from the game folder. Open Install to get it again.
dyn.play.err.missing_data: The game data is missing. Open Install to build it again.
dyn.play.err.exited_early: The game closed right after it started.
dyn.play.err.updating: An update is being applied. Play is possible when it is done.
dyn.play.err.io: The game could not be started.
dyn.play.err.game_running: The game is running. Close it first.
dyn.play.err.no_previous: There is no previous game version to go back to.
dyn.play.prev_have: Version {0} is kept from before the last update.
dyn.play.prev_title: Go back to the previous version?
dyn.play.prev_text: The game goes from v{1} back to v{0}. Your save is backed up first, as "Before restore". The newer version can be updated to again from the Home page.
